highlights.title: AI Capex, Gamble or Jackpot?: Market Snapshot
highlights.description: This week started with a striking warning from the Broadcom CEO, who likened the artificial intelligence market to a "casino." The statement was followed by strong earnings from ASML and a better-than-expected outlook from TSMC, though neither was enough to stem a global tech stock rout. Bloomberg's "The Opening Trade" spoke to analysts and experts about what this tells us about the state of expenditure within the booming trade and whether its becoming an increasingly riskier bet. (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: Apple Store Down Ahead of iPhone Duo Pre-Orders
ai.description:
Apple's online store is down ahead of iPhone Duo pre-orders, which begin at 5:00 a.m. Pacific Time on Friday, October 16.


"We love that early energy," reads the Apple Store's message when visiting the U.S. website. "Almost ready for you. Pre-order begins at 5:00 a.m. PT. See you soon." Apple has been opening pre-orders at 5:00 a.m. Pacific Time for several years, rather than the 12:01 a.m. start time it previously used.

Customers in more than 70 countries and regions, including Australia, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Japan, Mexico, the UAE, the UK, and the U.S., will be able to pre-order the ‌iPhone Duo‌ when the store comes back online.

The ‌iPhone Duo‌ is Apple's first foldable iPhone and comes in Star White and Night Sky. It is available in 256GB, 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB storage capacities. Here's what to know before placing an order:

ev_autonomous.title: Oops, Apple's Website Just Hinted at iPad Mini 8
ev_autonomous.description:
Apple has an unreleased iPad mini Smart Folio listed on its French regulatory website, hinting that a new ‌iPad mini‌ is coming. The case's A3632 model number doesn't match current or past ‌iPad mini‌ cases.


Apple appears to have added the case to its website recently, and it's listed alongside iPhone 18 Pro accessories added in September.

The listing doesn't include any ‌iPad mini‌ specs, but it does suggest design changes to the device it's meant for as a new Smart Folio may mean current cases won't fit the next ‌iPad mini‌.

OLED display and a more water-resistant design will be introduced on October 27 or 28 alongside an ‌OLED‌ MacBook Pro. The A3632 Smart Folio could be for the ‌OLED‌ ‌iPad mini‌.
